npcs.name: Gym Receptionist 1
npcs.meet_text: Welcome! Are you here to register for the Gym Hero Challenge as an entrant? The challenge entrance fee is $500 which must be paid in full up front. You need only pay once for full access to the challenge and you are welcome to enter and leave as often as you like while the challenge is ongoing.
npcs.repeat_text: Thank you! Your entrace fee is covered and your registration is complete. Please make your way through the door on the left to enter the challenge hall. You fill find the Gym Heros waiting for you in the main hall. Spectator access only is the door on the right.

npcs.name: Gym Receptionist 2
npcs.meet_text: The Gym Challenge is best of 3 format and you cannot use any of these cards: Lass, Super Energy Removal, Energy Removal, Rocket's Sneak Attack, Imposter Oak's Revenge, The Rocket's Trap, No Removal Gym or Chaos Gym
npcs.repeat_text: The Gym Challenge is best of 3 format and you cannot use any of these cards: Lass, Super Energy Removal, Energy Removal, Rocket's Sneak Attack, Imposter Oak's Revenge, The Rocket's Trap, No Removal Gym or Chaos Gym

npcs.name: Gym Receptionist 3
npcs.meet_text: Welcome! Sorry - If you're looking to register to enter the challenge, please speak with my colleague on the other side of the desk. She will be able to take your entrance fee and register you into the challenge. This side is spectator entrance only.
npcs.repeat_text: Welcome! Sorry - If you're looking to register to enter the challenge, please speak with my colleague on the other side of the desk. She will be able to take your entrance fee and register you into the challenge. This side is spectator entrance only.

npcs.name: Gym Security 1
npcs.meet_text: Only registered challengers may enter into the main hall via this door. Please speak with the registration desk to enter.
npcs.repeat_text: Only registered challengers may enter into the main hall via this door. Please speak with the registration desk to enter.

npcs.name: Gym Security 2
npcs.meet_text: This door is for spectator access only. Please use the door on the other side of the registration desk to enter the challenge hall.
npcs.repeat_text: This door is for spectator access only. Please use the door on the other side of the registration desk to enter the challenge hall.

npcs.name: Gym Shopkeeper
npcs.meet_text: Welcome! Purchase your gym hero and gym challenge packs here!
npcs.repeat_text: Welcome! Purchase your gym hero and gym challenge packs here!

opponents.name: Gym Challenge Brock
opponents.meet_text: I'm Brock, leader of Pewter Gym, and the Gym Challenge starts here with me. I lead with a rock hard defence. Are you ready to face my rock hard defence deck? Remember, the banned trainer cards aren't allowed in here.
opponents.repeat_text: Show me that rock hard resolve again!
opponents.first_win_text: Heh, you cracked right through my defence! You've earned the right to move on. Take this coin.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Still as solid as ever, but you're the stronger one.
opponents.loss_text: The best offense is a good defense! That's my way of doing things. Come back when your rocks are harder!
